records.name: Turn Golden
records.unlock_method: Progress the Frieza Race storyline in Frieza's Spaceship Time Rift and train with Frieza and Cooler.
records.effects_summary: Increases Ki Blast damage and movement speed; changes basic Ki Blasts while transformed.

records.name: Potential Unleashed
records.unlock_method: Z-rank the first five Advancement Tests, then complete the sixth/final Advancement Test.
records.effects_summary: Provides a general-purpose attack boost and improved defensive properties without a transformation drawback.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Reach level 90 or higher and max Friendship with Whis; Whis awards the skill.
records.effects_summary: Large all-attack increase with ongoing Ki drain.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan (Evolved)
records.unlock_method: Already obtain Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan, then reach level 95 or higher and max Friendship with Vegeta; Whis awards the skill.
records.effects_summary: Stronger offensive transformation than Super Saiyan Blue with substantially heavier Ki drain.
